BWA.note: Paratus hosting named in passing; no data centre for hire described.

facts.fact: Paratus Botswana says it has fibre routes out of Botswana, two into South Africa and one into Namibia, which links to the Equiano subsea cable at Swakopmund, with a fourth route to Zimbabwe and Zambia still being lit.
facts.system: Paratus BKF; Paratus routes to South Africa and Namibia

ZMB.note: The Paratus route to Livingstone is not in service.

ZWE.note: The Paratus route through Zimbabwe is not in service.
